verdict.rationale: Synctera is an API-first banking platform, so scoped API credentials are a fair question to ask. The evidence only shows that an API key is issued in Sandbox and that a team admin can grant access to team members. That is human user-role management, an adjacent control, not scoped or least-privilege API keys for an agent. No documentation shows API keys restricted by permission, resource or action.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
